Method of Attack: Encrypts files and appends various extensions such as *.EnCiPhErEd, *.0JELvV, *.p5tkjw, *.6FKR8d, *.UslJ6m, *.n1wLp0, *.5vypSa, *.YNhlv1; uses brute force to find decryption key by dragging a pair of files (one encrypted, one not) onto the decryptor
Impacted Systems: Files encrypted by Xorist ransomware family
